youtube.title: The Monster Living in the Sewer Under Your City 🤢 #shorts
youtube.description:
There's a monster growing in the sewer under your city 😳

It's called a fatberg. Wet wipes don't break down like toilet paper, and cooking grease poured down the sink cools and hardens in the pipes. Together they glue into a rock-hard blob that can block a whole sewer.

In 2017, workers in London found one under Whitechapel that weighed about 130 tonnes (as heavy as eleven double-decker buses) and stretched around 250 meters. It took a team about nine weeks to blast it apart with high-pressure hoses.

And right now, another one is growing... so only flush the 3 Ps: pee, poo and paper 🧻

🤢 Did you know about fatbergs? Tell me in the comments.
